ndaCountries.note: Addy v Commissioner of Taxation [2021] HCA 34. Resident rates apply only when the person is BOTH an Australian tax resident AND a national of one of these. The seven-country list in wide circulation omits Israel. The United States, South Korea and Iceland are excluded; the Iceland treaty rules the WHM rate out expressly. Wider twelve-country lists published by law firms describe every Australian treaty carrying a non-discrimination article and are not accepted by the ATO for this purpose.

ndaCountryStartYears.note: The Decision Impact Statement gives these start years. The main ATO guidance page now carries a qualifier for Israel as well, and still none for Germany. Re-verify before applying either to a prior-year amendment.

rhcaCountries.note: Nationals of these countries can enrol in Medicare while on a WHM visa, so they generally cannot obtain a full Medicare Entitlement Statement and a resident among them pays the levy. Coverage differs by country and by period, so this is a starting point for a question, not a lookup answer.

nonLodgementWageThreshold.note: Below this, with all income earned as WHM salary or wages, neither a return nor a non-lodgment advice is required. Lodging is still the only way to recover over-withholding or claim deductions.

lodgementDueDate.note: Self-lodgers. Engaging a registered tax agent before 31 October opens later concessional dates.

earlyLodgementProcessingDays.note: Business days, paper return only, and unavailable to anyone holding a HELP, AASL or VET Student Loan debt or still earning Australian income. Keeping myGov access and lodging from overseas after 1 July is usually faster.

medicareEntitlementStatementWindow.note: Applications open 1 July. If you are leaving Australia you can apply up to four weeks before your departure date and it is processed after you leave. Services Australia publishes no processing time; an earlier eight-week figure here came from no source and was removed.
